oneLine: Varmora Granito updated its DRHP featuring a ₹400 crore fresh issue.

sources.title: Varmora Granito Ltd. IPO: DRHP update, ₹400 crore fresh issue, business profile, financials, KPIs and risks

synopsis: Varmora Granito Limited has updated its draft red herring prospectus for an initial public offering featuring a fresh issue of four hundred crore rupees. The company manufactures and markets building materials including tiles, bathware, and adhesives, utilizing a mixed manufacturing model and a franchise-led pan-India distribution network. The filing follows observations from the Securities and Exchange Board of India and incorporates refreshed financial disclosures alongside details of a recent fifty-one percent stake acquisition in Allemby Ceramics Private Limited, which is developing a greenfield ceramic tiles facility in Tezpur, Assam. Final offer terms, price bands, and opening and closing dates remain subject to regulatory approvals and market conditions.
